name: PickPair – Upsell, Cross-sell & Product Recommendations for WooCommerce
author: YS Innovations

sections.description:
Every WooCommerce store owner wants customers to discover more of what they sell, without adding friction to the buying process. PickPair adds product recommendation campaigns at the points in the shopping journey where customers are already deciding what to buy: on the product page, in the cart, and at checkout.

Instead of relying on customers to search for accessories, complementary items, or related products on their own, store owners can present those choices at the right moment, in a layout that matches their existing theme.

PickPair works with Classic WooCommerce templates as well as WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks, so recommendation campaigns can be added without rebuilding existing page layouts.

Campaigns can be created for individual products, product categories, cart conditions, or specific customer scenarios, and multiple campaigns can run at the same time, each with its own display location, targeting rules, and recommended products.

In simple terms: when a customer is looking at a product, has items in their cart, or is about to check out, PickPair can show them one more relevant thing to buy — without them having to search for it.

Not sure which feature fits your goal?

  • Want customers to add related items on the product page → Frequently Bought Together or Product Page Add-ons
  • Want to sell products as a set at one price → Product Bundles
  • Want to offer services like warranties or gift wrapping → Product Page Add-ons or Checkout Recommendations
  • Want to increase the average order value at checkout → Cart Upsells or Checkout Recommendations
  • Want to suggest accessories once something is already in the cart → Cart Recommendations

What store owners can do with PickPair

  • Show “frequently bought together” style offers under a product
  • Build product bundles with required and optional items
  • Offer add-ons like warranties, gift wrapping, or installation services on the product page
  • Recommend related products inside the cart
  • Add upsell offers based on what’s already in the cart
  • Show recommendations at checkout before an order is placed
  • Set rules so campaigns only appear for the right products, categories, or customers
  • Track impressions, views, clicks, and conversions for each campaign

Frequently Bought Together

Customers often buy certain products together — a phone with a protective case, a laptop with a mouse, a camera with a memory card, a bicycle with a helmet, a printer with ink cartridges, or a coffee machine with capsules. Frequently Bought Together campaigns display these combinations directly on the product page, so customers can add several items to the cart in one step instead of searching for them separately.

Store owners can include:

  • Multiple recommended products per campaign
  • A mix of required and optional products
  • Dynamic pricing, percentage discounts, or fixed bundle pricing
  • Live price updates as selections change
  • Stock validation before items are added to the cart
  • Linked cart items, so if the main product is removed from the cart, its bundled items are removed too (this is what “parent-child cart relationships” means)

Product Bundles

Product Bundles let store owners group multiple products into a single purchasable offer. A bundle can contain only required products, only optional products, or a combination of both, depending on how much choice the customer should have.

Bundle pricing can be set as:

  • Dynamic, based on the items selected
  • A percentage discount off the combined price
  • A fixed bundle price

Bundle totals recalculate automatically as optional items are added or removed, and product availability is checked before anything is added to the cart.

Additional bundle capabilities include unlimited items per bundle, individual quantities per product, and stock validation on every bundled item.

Product Page Add-ons

Product Page Add-ons let store owners offer extra products or services alongside the main item, before the customer clicks “Add to Cart.” This is useful for gift wrapping, extended warranties, product protection plans, installation services, cleaning kits, matching accessories, or premium packaging.

Add-ons can be placed above the Add to Cart button, below it, or below the product summary, and each one can be configured as optional, pre-selected, or required. When a customer adds an add-on along with the main product, that relationship is preserved in the WooCommerce cart.

Cart Recommendations

Customers frequently review their cart before checking out, which makes it a useful place to suggest accessories, replacement parts, care items, gift wrapping, or protection plans related to what’s already there. Cart Recommendations use WooCommerce hooks to display these suggestions directly in the cart, and customers can add them without leaving the page.

Cart Recommendations include add-to-cart and remove actions, live subtotal updates, and mini-cart synchronization — all of which happen instantly on the page (this is what “AJAX” means), without the customer waiting for the page to reload.

Cart Upsells

Cart Upsells suggest additional products based on everything currently in the cart, rather than a single product page. Campaigns can be targeted by product, by category, or by cart subtotal, which makes this location useful for suggesting a next purchase once a customer has already committed to buying something.

Checkout Recommendations

Checkout Recommendations give store owners one more opportunity to offer relevant products or services — such as gift wrapping, extended warranties, protection plans, or installation — before the order is placed. This location works with both Classic WooCommerce Checkout and WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks, and recommendation panels refresh automatically as products are added.

Checkout Recommendations can run independently from Product Page Add-ons and Cart Recommendations, so store owners can decide exactly which offers appear at which stage.

Rules & Conditions

Recommendation campaigns are most useful when they show up at the right time for the right customer. PickPair’s Rules & Conditions system lets store owners control when a campaign appears, based on:

  • Products currently in the cart
  • Product categories
  • Cart subtotal
  • Cart quantity
  • Customer role
  • Previous orders
  • Impression limits (how many times the same customer sees a campaign, so offers don’t feel repetitive)

Conditions can be combined, so campaigns can be narrowed down to specific shopping scenarios rather than shown to every visitor.

Campaign Targeting

Each campaign can be scoped to the products and situations where it makes the most sense — for example, showing an accessory recommendation only when a specific product is in the cart, displaying a campaign only after a cart subtotal is reached, or showing different offers to different customer roles. Multiple campaigns can run at once, and each one can be targeted independently without affecting the others.

Campaign Analytics

Built-in reporting shows how each recommendation campaign is performing, including impressions, views, clicks, and conversions. Store owners can review this data per campaign to see which offers are working and which need adjusting.

WooCommerce Compatibility

PickPair works with standard WooCommerce products, including simple and variable products, product categories, the shopping cart, checkout, and WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks. It follows WordPress coding standards and is built to work alongside properly coded WordPress themes and plugins.

Responsive Layouts

Recommendation campaigns, bundles, add-ons, and cart and checkout recommendations all use responsive layouts that adapt to desktop, tablet, and mobile screens while matching the active WooCommerce theme.

AJAX Interactions

Adding products, removing products, updating pricing, refreshing cart totals, syncing the mini-cart, and updating recommendation panels all happen instantly on the page, without a full page reload. This keeps the shopping experience fast and keeps the cart accurate as customers make changes.

Store Types

PickPair can be used across a wide range of WooCommerce store categories, including electronics, fashion and apparel, home and furniture, beauty and cosmetics, automotive parts, sports equipment, pet supplies, health products, office supplies, books, toys and games, jewellery, food and beverage, and digital products. Campaigns can be configured differently for each product catalog depending on what a store sells.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.3 or later
  • WooCommerce
  • PHP 7.4 or later

Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New Plugin.
  3. Search for PickPair.
  4. Click Install Now.
  5. Activate the plugin.
  6. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  7. Navigate to WooCommerce → PickPair.
  8. Create your first recommendation campaign.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New Plugin → Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the ZIP file.
  4. Click Install Now.
  5. Activate the plugin.
  6. Configure recommendation campaigns from WooCommerce → PickPair.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated before using PickPair.

What recommendation types can I create?

You can create Frequently Bought Together campaigns, Product Bundles, Product Page Add-ons, Cart Recommendations, Cart Upsells, and Checkout Recommendations.

Can I offer discounts on Product Bundles?

Yes. Product Bundles support dynamic pricing, percentage discounts, and fixed bundle pricing.

Does this work with WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks?

Yes. PickPair supports both Classic WooCommerce templates and WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks.

Where can recommendations be displayed?

Recommendation campaigns can appear on product pages, in the shopping cart, and at checkout, depending on the campaign type you create.

Can I control when a campaign is shown?

Yes. Campaigns can be configured using conditions such as products in the cart, product categories, cart subtotal, customer role, previous orders, and impression limits.

Can I run more than one campaign at a time?

Yes. You can create multiple campaigns and manage each one independently, with its own products, display location, and conditions.

Can I see how my campaigns are performing?

Yes. Built-in analytics show impressions, views, clicks, and conversions for each campaign.

Will this work with my WooCommerce theme?

PickPair follows WordPress coding standards and is designed to work with properly coded WooCommerce themes.

Does this plugin change my existing products?

No. PickPair works alongside your existing WooCommerce products without modifying your product data. Recommendation campaigns are managed separately.

I run a small store — is this too complex to set up?

No coding is required. Campaigns are created and managed from the WooCommerce → PickPair screen in your dashboard, and each campaign type is configured on its own, so you can start with one recommendation type (such as Frequently Bought Together) and add others later.

Will this slow down my store?

Recommendation panels are built to load efficiently and use AJAX (instant, on-page updates) for cart actions, so customers don’t wait on full page reloads when adding recommended products.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Added Frequently Bought Together campaigns.
  • Added Product Bundles.
  • Added Product Page Add-ons.
  • Added Cart Recommendations.
  • Added Cart Upsells.
  • Added Checkout Recommendations.
  • Added Rules & Conditions.
  • Added campaign targeting by products, categories, cart subtotal, customer roles, and previous orders.
  • Added Campaign Analytics.
  • Added WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks support.
  • Added AJAX-powered cart interactions.
  • Added responsive frontend layouts.
  • Added stock validation for bundled products.
  • Added parent-child cart relationships.
